 Live IBPS PO Mains Result 2026 Live: Direct Link to Download Scorecard PDF Soon at ibps.in
 By Sunil Sharma Nov 20, 2026, 12:58 IST 
 IBPS PO Result 2026: The Institute of Banking Personnel Selection will shortly release the IBPS PO Mains Result 2026 on its official website, ibps.in. Check out this live blog for the latest updates on the IBPS PO Mains Result.
 IBPS PO Mains Result 2026 HIGHLIGHTS 
 IBPS PO Mains Result 2026 is expected to be released today.
 IBPS is hiring around 7,565 jobs across the country for Probationary Officers (PO) Posts.
 Candidates can download the IBPS PO Mains Scorecard PDF from the official website once released.
 Register for Result Updates IBPS PO 2026 Result: The Institute of Banking Personnel Selection (IBPS) will shortly release the IBPS PO Mains Result 2026. Candidates can download the CRP CSA (Customer Service Associate) XVI Mains scorecard PDF from the official website of the Institute of Banking Personnel Selection: ibps.in, once it is officially released.
The IBPS PO exam was held on October 4, 2026, at designated test centres spread across the country. Through this recruitment drive, the IBPS will fill up 7,565 posts of Probationary Officers (PO).
Candidates who clear the mains exam will move to the next stages, which are the Personality Test and Common Interview. Check out this article for the result link, scorecard, and other latest updates on IBPS PO mains result 2026.
 IBPS PO 2026 Result Date (Expected) 
 Candidates who appeared for the mains exam are eagerly waiting for the result to know their qualifying status for the next stages. However, the Institute of Banking Personnel Selection (IBPS) has not yet announced the official IBPS PO 2026 result date. Based on previous years’ trends, the result is expected to be released within 6-7 weeks of the examination. Since the Mains conducted on October 4, 2026, aspirants can expect the IBPS PO Result to be available on the official website anytime soon. Once released, candidates can check their IBPS PO Results using their registration number and password. 
 How to Check IBPS PO Result 2026 
 Candidates who appeared for the IBPS PO 2026 exam can check their IBPS PO Results online through the official IBPS website. To access the result, candidates need to use their registration number and password/date of birth. Follow the below-mentioned steps to know how to check the IBPS PO result 2026. 
 Step 1: Visit the official website of IBPS- ibps.in 
 Step 2: Scroll down and click on ‘CRP PO/MT XVI Mains Result Download Link’ 
 Step 3: A new page will open; click on the mains result link 
 Step 4: Fill in all the details like Registration No / Roll No, Password / DOB   and security captcha and click on ‘Login’. 
 Step 5: The Admit Card will appear on the screen. 
 Step 6: Download and print the admit card PDF. 
 Details on IBPS PO Result 2026 Scorecard PDF 
 Institute of Banking Personnel Selection (IBPS) will shortly release the IBPS PO result 2026 scorecard PDF on the official website. The IBPS PO scorecard will contain the following information. 
 Candidate’s Name 
 Roll Number 
 Registration Number 
 Qualifying Status 
 Total Marks 
 Marks Obtained 
 Result Date 
 LIVE UPDATES Check Latest Updates Nov 20, 2026, 12:58 IST IBPS PO Mains Result 2026 LIVE: Result still awaited
 The Institute of Banking Personnel Selection (IBPS) has not yet activated the mains result link for the 7,565 Probationary Officer (PO) posts. Candidates should keep checking the official website of IBPS for the mains result and scorecard. Those who qualify will appear for the next stages of the selection process. The result 2026 is expected to be released today, November 20, 2026. We will update this page with the direct link, cut-off marks and next steps as soon as IBPS announces them.
 Nov 20, 2026, 12:10 IST IBPS PO Mains Result 2026 LIVE: What's Next After the Mains Result
 Candidates who qualify in the mains exam will be eligible for the next stage of selection, which includes the Personality Test and Common Interview. First, download your scorecard as a PDF and save a copy. Then keep a watch on the official website of IBPS for the dates of the next stage. Candidates who could not qualify can use their scorecard to find weak areas and prepare early for the next recruitment.
 Nov 19, 2026, 13:20 IST IBPS PO Mains Result 2026 LIVE: Total Number of Vacancies
 The Institute of Banking Personnel Selection (IBPS) announced 6,715 vacancies for Probationary Officer (PO) and Management Trainee (MT) posts under the Common Recruitment Process (CRP) PO/MT-XVI. This number was increased to 7,365 in July and later raised again by 200 posts in August to reach 7,565 vacancies.

 Nov 18, 2026, 17:09 IST IBPS PO Mains Result 2026 LIVE: Likely by Late Evening; Keep Checking this Live Blog
 IBPS has declared results late in the evening in the past. Last year the Prelims result was released late in the evening on September 23, 2026. So the result link can go live at any time November 18. Candidates should check the official website. We will also keep updating this live blog with the latest information. Stay tuned with us.
 Nov 18, 2026, 10:39 IST IBPS PO Mains Result 2026 LIVE: Result Can Be Released Anytime Soon
 Institute of Banking Personnel Selection (IBPS) is expected to declare the mains result for the Probationary Officers (PO) post today, November 18, 2026. IBPS has not given an exact time, so the link can become active at any moment, even late in the evening. Candidates should keep the official website open and keep their login details ready. We will add the direct link here as soon as it is active.
 Nov 17, 2026, 19:12 IST IBPS PO Mains Result 2026 LIVE: Will Mains Cut Off be Released with the Result?
 Yes, IBPS will released the IBPS PO Mains Cut Off 2026 along with the result. The cut-off will be state-wise and category-wise, so the required marks depend on vacancies, competition and exam difficulty. Last year, IBPS published the cut-off along with the result. Candidates should compare their score with the cut-off for their own state and category, not with an all-India figure. We will add the 2026 cut-off here as soon as IBPS releases it.
 Nov 17, 2026, 18:32 IST IBPS PO Mains Result 2026 Live: Keep Login Details Ready
 Candidates should keep their application number and password ready before the result release. This will help them check the result quickly without any delay. Candidates who forget their login details should recover them before the release date. Candidates should keep the following details ready.
 Application Number
 Password
 Nov 17, 2026, 18:06 IST IBPS PO Mains Result 2026 Live: Official Website to Check Result
 Candidates can check their IBPS PO Mains Result 2026 from the official of Institute of Banking Personnel Selection (IBPS) ibps.in. The download link will be activated once the result are released officially.
 Nov 17, 2026, 16:54 IST IBPS PO Mains Result 2026 LIVE: Result Expected Today, Link Yet to be Active
 The Institute of Banking Personnel Selection (IBPS) is expected to released the IBPS PO Mains Result 2026 today, November 17, 2026. The result will be released for Common Recruitment Process (CRP) Probationary Officers / Management Trainees XVI. IBPS has not yet activated the link, so candidates should wait for the official update. Keep refreshing this page for the direct link as soon as it goes live.

 Nov 16, 2026, 17:51 IST IBPS PO Mains Result 2026 is Expected Today
 Previous trends suggest that the Institute of Banking Personnel Selection (IBPS) can release the IBPS PO Mains Result 2026 today on its official website. The result will be released for the 7565 vacancies. Candidates who appeared for the mains exam held on October 4 can check their mains exam scorecard online once the link is activated.
 What after the IBPS PO Mains Result 2026? 
 The candidates who clear the mains exam will be called for the next stages, which includes Personality Test and Common Interview. The Personality Test checks your behavior and habits for the panel, while the Common Interview is a face-to-face talk to decide if you are fit to be a bank officer.
